name: Odyssey
description: Odyssey – The Literary Society of KIET is a vibrant platform where creativity meets confidence. The club is dedicated to enhancing students’ communication skills, critical thinking, and artistic expression through various literary activities. It provides a stage for students to express ideas freely, refine their personality, and develop LSRW (Listening, Speaking, Reading, Writing) skills in an engaging manner.

achievements.title: Academic Enrichment and Student Development
achievements.desc: Successfully reinforced the institution's commitment to holistic student development through high-level collaborative initiatives and interactive sessions with eminent personalities.

achievements.title: Promotion of Creative and Intellectual Engagement
achievements.desc: Successfully created a supportive and dynamic space for student engagement, fostering a culture of critical thinking and articulate expression.

events.title: KIET Knowledge Series (Odyssey × MUN Collaboration)
events.desc: A collaborative initiative aimed at bridging the gap between theoretical knowledge and real-life applications through sessions with speakers like Atul Garg, Vyomika Singh, and Deepak Vohra.

events.title: Odyssey Open Sessions 2025
events.desc: An inclusive platform for students to present poetry, storytelling, public speaking, and creative performances to enhance communication and soft skills.
